financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Jefferies ATM sales, Oct 1 to Nov 5, 2024 (8,131,121 shares at $2.38 weighted-average)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: From October 1, 2024 through November 5, 2024, we sold an aggregate of 8,131,121 shares of common stock at a weighted-average price of $2.38 through the Jefferies ATM Offering Program for net proceeds of $18.8 million.
